groups.title: Tagging Taxonomy Design

groups.title: Tag Policy Enforcement
groups.question: Walk through how you would enforce tagging rules across many AWS accounts or Azure subscriptions.

followUps.AWS Tag Policies via Organizations: Why set tag rules at the organization level instead of in each account?
followUps.Azure Policy for Required Tags: What is the trade-off of denying resource creation when a required tag is missing?

groups.title: GCP Label Enforcement
groups.question: Explain how you would make sure GCP resources carry the labels you need for cost reports.

followUps.GCP Organization Policy for Labels: Why do labels matter so much when you need cost detail below the project level in GCP?
followUps.Tag Coverage Monitoring and Reporting: How would you use a tag coverage metric to drive teams toward compliance?

groups.title: Shared Cost Allocation Strategies
groups.question: Walk through how you would handle costs that no single team clearly owns.

followUps.Automated Tagging Remediation: What risk comes with automatically applying default tags to untagged resources?
